svg.title: Compare Job Contribution Before Fixed Operating Costs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-contribution-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Job Contribution Before Fixed Operating Costs; subtitle: Five illustrative service and payment-path combinations.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are hypothetical contribution percentages: billings less job-variable costs, divided by billings. They are not observed market averages, net margins, or an annual service mix; do not add the percentages.; caption: Use actual job-cost records to replace these planning inputs. The canonical Base-Case net margin remains 13.0% after all costs.; stages: label: Clean-water mitigation; value: 45% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Customer-authorized extraction and drying with itemized equipment days; customer payment or insurer remittance must be reconciled to the same contract balance.; label: Fire and smoke cleaning; value: 40% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Document affected surfaces, cleaning methods, and contents handling; disputed cleaning scope can delay collection despite completed field labor.; label: Mold remediation; value: 38% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 38.0; detail: Use required remediation credentials and project protocols; customer-funded work remains collectible under its contract even when coverage is excluded.; label: Storm stabilization; value: 35% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 35.0; detail: Separate emergency protection from permanent repair; weather exposure, access equipment, and crew travel can erode initially attractive invoice yields.; label: Reconstruction; value: 28% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 28.0; detail: Align progress invoices with completed milestones; mortgage-servicer endorsements, retainage, and trade rework can extend the cash conversion cycle.

text.title: Compare Job Contribution Before Fixed Operating Costs
text.tspan: Compare Job Contribution Before Fixed Operating Costs

circle.title: label: Clean-water mitigation; value: 45% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Customer-authorized extraction and drying with itemized equipment days; customer payment or insurer remittance must be reconciled to the same contract balance.

label: Fire and smoke cleaning; value: 40% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Document affected surfaces, cleaning methods, and contents handling; disputed cleaning scope can delay collection despite completed field labor.

label: Mold remediation; value: 38% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 38.0; detail: Use required remediation credentials and project protocols; customer-funded work remains collectible under its contract even when coverage is excluded.

label: Storm stabilization; value: 35% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 35.0; detail: Separate emergency protection from permanent repair; weather exposure, access equipment, and crew travel can erode initially attractive invoice yields.

label: Reconstruction; value: 28% illustrative job contribution; numeric value: 28.0; detail: Align progress invoices with completed milestones; mortgage-servicer endorsements, retainage, and trade rework can extend the cash conversion cycle.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are hypothetical contribution percentages: billings less job-variable costs, divided by billings. They are not observed market averages, net margins, or an annual service mix; do not add the percentages.
